main.description: Admits the requesting user to a community. Joining is an AppView procedure rather than a record the user writes, because admission is what makes the community's spaces readable to them.

status.description: The result of the join attempt.

member.description: The new member view. Present only when status is joined.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: InvitationNotFound
errors.description: No invitation exists with that code.

errors.name: AlreadyMember
errors.description: The requesting user already holds a member record in this community.

errors.name: Banned
errors.description: The requesting user is banned from this community.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.
